summary: Tested own-profile email change (PUT /api/auth/profile), super_admin email edit of other users (PUT /api/admin/users/{id}), and Facebook import (POST /api/admin/facebook/import) through the API and the UI. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass. UI: the profile email flow (password field appears, wrong-password toast, save, restore), Users dialog email edit plus duplicate-email error, the FB import dialog (sample checkbox unchecked, result 'Objavljeno: 0 · Već uvezeno ranije: 5') and the public homepage/article rendering all work. Sample articles were not deleted (removed_samples=0, 8 'primjer' articles still active). All changed emails were restored and TEST_ users deleted.

minor.issue: Imported articles get author_ids = importing user. The 5 live articles currently show the byline 'TEST_FB Admin' publicly (created by the test account). Reassign them to the owner/Redakcija, or let import use a configurable default author.
The user asked for 8 posts, but the FB page plugin only exposes 5. Only 5 real posts exist; the UI does not tell the user this limit.
All-caps titles are lowercased word-by-word, which breaks acronyms/units, e.g. 'Na prodaju mini cooper s 1.6 – 135 kw!' (should be Mini Cooper S, kW).
Email change does not revoke other sessions or notify the old address (security hardening suggestion).

Pre-existing: a non-super_admin holding users.manage via extra_permissions can still change role/password of a super_admin (only the email is guarded). Consider blocking edits to super_admin accounts by non-super_admins.

issues:
The summary is the first body paragraph, so the lead text appears twice (summary + first

).

2 of the 5 FB posts have no image and show the CCN logo placeholder in the hero side cards; the hero is still the sample 'Primjer glavne vijesti' (pinned/breaking sample) since samples were intentionally kept.
'Obriši probne primjer članke' is checked by default, a destructive default. Also the toast 'Uvezeno 0 objava' is shown as a success when nothing was imported.

action_items: Change the author of the 5 imported FB articles from 'TEST_FB Admin' to the real owner/Redakcija (and consider a default author for imports)
Tell the user in the FB import UI that Facebook only exposes about 5 latest posts
Improve make_title casing for all-caps posts (keep acronyms/units)
Optional: avoid duplicating the summary as the first paragraph for imported posts; default remove_samples checkbox to unchecked
critical_code_review_comments: fb_import: posts are deduplicated by createdTime key only. That is OK, but an article that was soft-deleted still blocks re-import (find_one has no deleted filter). This is probably intended.
fb_import: image download failures are silently swallowed (except Exception). Consider logging them.
routes_admin.update_user: the email guard is role-based (super_admin) while the rest of the endpoint is permission-based; super_admin accounts are not protected from users.manage holders.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ users (journalist, chief_editor + users.manage, test_ui_user) were created and deleted. test_fb@ccn.ba email was changed to test_fb2@ccn.ba and restored. One FB import was run with remove_samples=false (imported 0, skipped 5).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the pytest with '-n 0' (pytest.ini uses xdist). The container date is Nov 2026, so the FB published dates (2026-11-08) match today. The 5 FB articles have fb_post_key; 3 have featured images. Do not run the import with remove_samples=true.
